figure: Figure 20.1 (Fleet capacity vs host count), aggregate-rps note
issue: The note states the 21/22-host planning sizing 'delivers ~41.5 rps ~ 1.04x peak', but 41.5 rps is the analytical capacity C_analytic at 21 hosts (21 x 1.977 = 41.5), i.e. headroom, not the served rate. Using 'delivers' for 41.5 contradicts the S curve drawn on the same page and the body on p.320, which carefully separates C_analytic / C_eff / S.
evidence: Note text: 'the 21/22-host planning sizing, which delivers ~41.5 rps ~ 1.04x peak'; legend: 'actually-served demand S = min(40, C_eff)'; the blue solid S line is flat at 40 for N >= ~22; body p.320 defines C_analytic(N) = N x 17/8.6 and S = min(40, C_eff).
acceptance_test: Reword the note so 41.5 rps is explicitly the analytical capacity / ~4% headroom (C_analytic at 21 hosts), and state the served demand is capped at the 40 rps peak (39.4 rps at 21 hosts, 40 rps at 22 hosts), consistent with the S curve and p.320.
